description: This PHP source file defines the AWS IoT Things Graph client class, providing method signatures for interacting with the AWS IoT Things Graph service, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: IoTThingsGraphClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS IoT Things Graph service, extending the generic AwsClient and providing specific methods for service operations.

methods.name: associateEntityToThing
methods.description: Associates an entity with a thing in the IoT Things Graph service.

methods.name: createFlowTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new flow template in the IoT Things Graph service.

methods.name: createSystemInstance
methods.description: Creates a new system instance within the service.

methods.name: dissociateEntityFromThing
methods.description: Removes an association between an entity and a thing.

methods.name: getFlowTemplate
methods.description: Gets details of a flow template.

methods.name: getFlowTemplateRevisions
methods.description: Retrieves revisions of a flow template.

methods.name: getNamespaceDeletionStatus
methods.description: Gets the deletion status of a namespace.

methods.name: getSystemInstance
methods.description: Retrieves details of a system instance.

methods.name: getSystemTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves details of a system template.

methods.name: getSystemTemplateRevisions
methods.description: Retrieves revisions of a system template.
